text:
Maria H: FYI a customer flagged a broken anchor in the onboarding quickstart (runtime section). the link goes to /runtime#kv-cache and returns 404 after the nav reshuffle. anyone own that page?
Ben C: hmm i moved some sidebar items last week, might be related. tagging owners: @Rika @Sam (infra) to confirm.
Rika: i edited the nav but didn't intentionally rename anchors. can you paste the exact failing URL?
Maria H: it's https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kv-cache — looks like the real anchor now is #kv-cache-optimization. quickstart still points to the old one.
Sam (infra): easy fix: either re-add the legacy anchor (HTML alias) or update the quickstart link. prefer to add an alias so older links keep working.
Jess: i'm fine with alias + changelog note so support doesn't get confused.
Maria H: i opened a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12399 — adds the old anchor and updates the quickstart reference. PTAL.
Ben C: taking a look, one markdown spacing nit but otherwise small. will leave review. :thumbsup:
Rika: if Ben is good, i can merge after CI. also suggest we add a short label like `docs:owners` to make these handoffs easier.
Sam (infra): also propose adding a CI smokecheck to catch moved anchors. quick script idea to run in dev: 
```
# dev-only check: detect internal docs links that 404
rg "\]\(https?://docs.redwood.ai" -n | cut -d\) -f1 | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'url=$(echo {} | sed -E "s/.*\((https?:.*)\).*/\1/"); curl -sSfL "$url" >/dev/null || echo "BROKEN: $url"'
```
Maria H: i'll file a ticket for an anchor smokecheck and add the script suggestion.
docs-bot: reminder: please add labels `#docs` and `#owner` for runbook changes.
Ben C: left one tiny inline comment. updated review pending.
Maria H: fixed spacing and force-pushed. merging once CI green. thanks all. :rocket:
Rika: nice, can someone drop the PR URL into INC-4821 so support sees the update?
Maria H: done — incident updated.
Ben C: CI passed and PR merged. :white_check_mark:
Jess: great, small win for docs health. i'll note this in the owners spreadsheet under "nav drift" so we can watch for patterns. lunch? :bento:
